## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` — thresholds are a ratchet, not a target to lower
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Documented behaviour still matches the code (README snippets are compiled in CI)
